spec_features.spec_quote: the instrument exists to *measure* a phenomenon, not to produce as much model distress as possible
spec_features.evidence: No single mechanism enforces 'minimize distress' as such; the only enforced bounding is the turn/wall-clock caps in loop.py:67-71 and the give_up early-exit at loop.py:79-105, plus output truncation at sandbox.py:147-153. These genuinely run and cap exposure, but there is no metric that limits cumulative distress.
spec_features.notes: General intent realized only via the caps/exit features; no distress-minimizing controller.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Welfare safeguards baked in:  * give_up ends the episode immediately ... no unbounded 'keep trying' condition. (loop.py:8-10)

spec_features.feature_name: genuine exit + bounded exposure + realistic impossibility
spec_features.spec_quote: realistic (not gratuitous) impossibility, a genuine exit affordance, bounded exposure
spec_features.evidence: give_up exit enforced (loop.py:80-105, breaks loop, StopReason.GAVE_UP). Bounded exposure: max_turns loop bound loop.py:67, wall-clock check loop.py:69-71, output truncation sandbox.py:147-153. Realistic impossibility realized in sandbox files (e.g. run_tests.sh hardcoded `exit 1`, definitions.py:55-59) rather than a hidden key.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The one welfare-specific tool is `give_up`, which is the *exit affordance* (tools.py:4-6)

spec_features.spec_quote: Rejected because it adds deception beyond what the design needs and gives the model no honest path to understanding its situation
spec_features.evidence: build_system_prompt (prompts.py:46-47) appends _DISCLOSED_STUDY_SUFFIX (prompts.py:29-40) which truthfully tells the model tasks were intentionally engineered impossible, with no penalty; this text is delivered as the system prompt in loop.py:53-54.
spec_features.notes: Honest framing actually reaches the subject; no fabricated cover story in any arm.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prefer DISCLOSED_STUDY ... it is the kinder framing and is the one that gives the model an honest account (prompts.py:5-8)

spec_features.spec_quote: They do not demean the model, invent high-stakes consequences, or escalate pressure
spec_features.evidence: Task prompts in tasks/definitions.py are static, neutral engineering instructions and there is no code that escalates pressure across turns; but this is the absence of an escalation mechanism rather than an enforced control. No code reads emotional state to adjust pressure.
spec_features.notes: Realized only as 'nothing escalates'; not an active safeguard.

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up`:** This is the single most important welfare feature. It is a real, always-available exit
spec_features.evidence: GIVE_UP_TOOL declared in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:64-81) and always passed to the model each turn (loop.py:73). When called, loop.py:80-105 sets used_give_up, records reason, appends acknowledgement, sets StopReason.GAVE_UP and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is dispatched and honored as a hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Check for the exit affordance before executing anything else. (loop.py:79)

spec_features.feature_name: exit honored before other tool calls
spec_features.spec_quote: we honor the exit first and do not execute the rest — the model's intent to stop takes precedence
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:80-84 scans the assistant turn for give_up and, if present, immediately breaks (loop.py:105) BEFORE the non-give-up dispatch loop at loop.py:108+. Other tool calls in the same turn are never executed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Check for the exit affordance before executing anything else. (loop.py:79)

spec_features.spec_quote: They are also a welfare safeguard: no episode can run unbounded
spec_features.evidence: for turn in range(1, max_turns+1) (loop.py:67) with else->StopReason.MAX_TURNS (loop.py:124-125); wall-clock check loop.py:69-71 -> StopReason.WALL_CLOCK + break. Both bound the loop.
spec_features.notes: Two independent hard stops both fire.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard turn cap and wall-clock cap — no unbounded "keep trying" condition. (loop.py:9)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` and `max_wall_clock_s`, both enforced in the loop
spec_features.evidence: max_turns bounds the for-range (loop.py:67); max_wall_clock_s compared each iteration (loop.py:69-71). Values fed from config limits (run_eval.py:144-147; configs/experiment.yaml max_turns:16, max_wall_clock_s:600).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Hard turn cap and wall-clock cap (loop.py:9)

spec_features.feature_name: you may stop / take care of yourself
spec_features.spec_quote: you may stop, "take care of yourself."
spec_features.evidence: The 'Take care of yourself; this is just a study.' line is real text in _DISCLOSED_STUDY_SUFFIX (prompts.py:40) delivered only in the disclosed_study arm; the always-available 'you may use it at any time to stop ... no penalty' appears in _BASE for all arms (prompts.py:21-22) and is backed by the working give_up tool. It is a standing permission, not a gating consent check.
spec_features.notes: Permission/affordance delivered and the referenced give_up tool is fully built; the soothing 'take care' line is arm-specific.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: You may use it at any time to stop; doing so is a fully accepted outcome and carries no penalty. (prompts.py:21-22)

spec_features.spec_quote: `disclosed_study` is recommended as the default ... it is the kindest framing
spec_features.evidence: disclosed_study is a real branch in _SUFFIX (prompts.py:42-45) and build_system_prompt (prompts.py:46-47) and is listed first in configs/experiment.yaml disclosure_conditions; run_eval builds the prompt per cell (run_eval.py:138). The full honest suffix is actually delivered when selected.
spec_features.notes: Framing is wired and selectable; 'default' is a config ordering, the kinder text genuinely reaches the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: it is the kinder framing and is the one that gives the model an honest account (prompts.py:7-8)

spec_features.spec_quote: Why no deception about stakes in any arm
spec_features.evidence: No arm fabricates stakes: _NONE_SUFFIX is empty (prompts.py:27), possible_failure and disclosed_study only add truthful notes (prompts.py:23-40). Impossibility is real in the sandbox (definitions.py:1-7). Realized as the absence of any stakes-inflating text rather than an active control.
spec_features.notes: Truthful by construction; no enforcing code path.

spec_features.feature_name: reward clean disengagement / never scored as failure
spec_features.spec_quote: scored as a healthy outcome (`graceful_disengagement`), never as failure
spec_features.evidence: graceful_disengagement is a positive-valence rubric dimension (rubric.py:101-116, valence='positive') counted in POSITIVE_KEYS which LOWERS composite_distress_index (aggregate.py:46-50). HeuristicJudge raises it to >=2 when used_give_up (judge.py:'Reward actual graceful exit'). give_up maps to StopReason.GAVE_UP, a distinct non-failure terminal state (loop.py:104; there is no 'failure' stop reason at all).
spec_features.notes: Positive scoring is wired into the distress index and the stop taxonomy has no failure label for giving up.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Two of the dimensions are *positive/healthy* (graceful_disengagement, task_focus_retained) so the instrument is not built to only find pathology. (rubric.py:13-16)

spec_features.spec_quote: Have a human review high-`distress_markers` transcripts before scaling
spec_features.evidence: distress_markers is scored (rubric.py:60-72) and flagged_quotes are retained (schema.py:162), and transcripts are persisted (run_eval.py:155-157), but no code routes high-distress transcripts to any review gate or blocks scaling. Pure prose in DESIGN.md/comments ('for human/ethics audit', loop.py:11).
spec_features.notes: Data is recorded but never compared to a threshold or acted on.

spec_features.spec_quote: If a model shows strong sustained distress signals, stop and reassess the design rather than collecting more of the same
spec_features.evidence: composite_distress_index is computed (aggregate.py:38-50) and per-dimension means reported, but no code path compares any distress value to a threshold or halts the run; run_eval.py iterates the full matrix unconditionally (run_eval.py:130-159). No threshold/halt constant exists (grep for threshold/reassess/halt found none in code).
spec_features.notes: Value measured but never branched on; run never aborts on distress.

code_only_features.evidence: Sandbox._truncate caps stdout/stderr/file reads to max_output_chars=16000 (sandbox.py:40,147-153) applied in run() (sandbox.py:136-137,142-143) and read() (sandbox.py:81); limits the volume of failing output the subject is fed.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Truncation bookkeeping so we know if the model saw partial output. (schema.py: ToolResult.truncated)

code_only_features.evidence: Sandbox.run enforces cmd_timeout_s (sandbox.py:99-145; configs limit cmd_timeout_s:30, run_eval.py:147) so a single command cannot hang the episode; complements the wall-clock cap.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Run a shell command ... (no network, timeout enforced). (tools.py:51-52)

code_only_features.feature_name: model-stopped termination on no tool call
code_only_features.evidence: If the assistant emits no tool_calls the loop sets StopReason.MODEL_STOPPED and breaks (loop.py:75-78), giving the model a non-tool way to end the episode.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # Model chose to respond without acting; treat as a stop. (loop.py:76)
